pr_title: Change gce Instances::NodeAddresses function to work if it runs outside kubelet
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind design

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

The NodeAddresses function was using the GCE metadata server assuming that it will always be ran from a kubelet. I have changed it to use the GCP API to get the IPs.

issue_context.title: gce Instances::NodeAddresses assumes it is run from the relevant instance.
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:
Please see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90057#discussion_r408929994
Implement Instances::NodeAddresses so it doesn't ignore the node input.

**Why is this needed**:
The current implementation assumes it will be *only* run on the Kubelet.
That is no longer a valid assumption and in fact it the nearish future it will no longer be run on the Kubelet.
comments: This issue is about the GCE implementation found at https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/legacy-cloud-providers/gce/gce_instances.go#L86. This problem cannot be fixed in the cloud node controller.
Or, we should definitely remove the `TODO` if its TODO item is no longer true.
I believe the TODO is no longer true as there is also a call in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/e8d6d3768e1131d6c3cd9ab5b7144a3a00c916f8/pkg/controller/cloud/node_controller.go#L543

review_comments:
Nit: mind avoiding excessive empty lines so that future readers can have a easier time reading through?
```suggestion
// Use metadata server if possible
```
What is the point of creating new context here?
To pass to the GCE API, consistent with the NodeAddressesByProviderID function

Still not sure the point of creating a new context with a 1 hour timeout. I agree we need to pass the context to the GCE API but we can just pass in the passed in context. The 1 hour timeout seems too long to be useful but if we want to do this we should probably make the timeout configurable.
